name: m2a2_woundall
_comment: M2a.2 VictoryCounter board. Declares victoryCounter woundAll explicitly (custom mission, concept 3.3.0 v3.5): the win is 'every hero wounded at least once', progress irreversible. Scenario variants may override the counter per scenario JSON (scenarios_m2a2.json 'victoryCounter'). No roundLimit, no triggers -> posture class Eliminate; the W value function then IS the counter delta.
